title: Degree modifiers scope over an adjacent property
summary: Test whether a recurring modifier-like whole changes the interpreted degree of an adjacent property across paired records, rather than naming a material or acting as a generic connector.

design.mechanism: A degree operator composes with the immediately adjacent property field and leaves the property carrier unchanged.
design.unit: complete modifier-property pairs with a fixed property candidate and an independently ordered comparison context
design.contrast: same property with and without the candidate modifier, matched for owner/register and field position
design.prediction: The modifier changes the ordered degree class or threshold consistently within a source scope while preserving property identity; a material/action reading predicts no degree-specific shift.
design.falsifier: Paired contexts show no ordered degree contrast, or the apparent effect follows owner/register alone; no post-hoc threshold may be chosen.
design.scope: existing admitted paired contexts only; feasibility_unknown for an independent ordinal degree scale
design.related: Distinct from amount conservation and result latency: it asks compositional degree scope, not conserved quantity or timing
